description: This source file defines the MapProcessor class, which handles processing of map-like data structures by executing a sequence of processing steps, including transforming strings and applying simple map processes. It includes methods for initializing from XML configuration and executing processing logic on input maps.

classes.name: MapProcessor
classes.description: Main class responsible for processing mappings with configured processing steps, initialized from an XML element.

methods.name: MapProcessor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MapProcessor instance from an XML element, parsing child elements to set up processing steps.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the configured processing steps on the provided input map, updating the results, messages, based on locale and class loader.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name attribute of this MapProcessor instance.
